## Overview
Mukul Sharma is a Cyber Security Engineer, AWS Cloud Architect, and AI/IoT solution builder completing his final year B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering (Cyber Security) at Lovely Professional University (LPU).

## Key Accomplishments & Publications
- **DASGRI Congress 2026 Publication**: Author of published research on AI-IoT landslide prediction & early warning disaster monitoring systems.
- **EcoGeoGuard**: AI/IoT disaster mitigation hardware-software system for real-time slope movement and landslide prediction.
- **INVENTROX**: AI-driven inventory tracking and analytics engine for modern enterprise logistics.
- **Space Galactus**: Interactive 3D astronomical simulation platform.
- **AYUSH VR Garden**: Virtual reality medicinal plants immersive educational portal.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Cyber Security**: Penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, network defense, secure system design, cryptographic implementation.
- **Cloud Architecture & DevOps**: AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch), Cloudflare, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code.
- **AI/ML & IoT**: Edge AI deployment, sensor telemetry, predictive modeling, voice AI assistant development.
- **Full-Stack Development**: React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Start, Node.js, Tailwind CSS v4, Python, C++.
